title: Around The Post Wide Ball (Michelle Grogan)
style: fast phonk progressive trance heavy bongo bass guitar 136bpm pickleball training high energy English Spanish coach calls no slow sections
lyrics:
[Intro]
Wide ball out beyond the sideline post
Around the post, that is what matters most

[Verse 1]
Ball lands wide and low beyond the post
Step out wide, paddle face stays coast
Aim around the outside of the post frame
Around the post, no height needed in the game

No need to clear the net height at the post
Net is lowest at center, highest at the coast
Around the post means contact below net height
Around the post, angle it just right

[Pre-Chorus]
Step wide, paddle low, go around
No net clearance needed at the ground
Aim past the post, not over the tape
Around the post, that is the great escape

[Chorus]
Around the post wide ball, step out wide
Paddle low, aim past the post side
No net to clear, angle around
Around the post wide ball, legal and sound

[Verse 2]
When is the around the post shot on
Ball below net height, wide, and long
Three factors needed, wide and low and out
Around the post, without a doubt

[Bridge]
Bluey: SHE IS GOING AROUND THE POST, spectacular awareness from Michelle
Trevor: The ball was forty centimetres below net height at contact, perfect conditions for the ATP
Michelle: Wide. Low. Angle around. Three conditions. All three must be there.

[Chorus]
Around the post wide ball, step out wide
Paddle low, aim past the post side
No net to clear, angle around
Around the post wide ball, legal and sound

[Outro]
Wide, low, angle around
Three conditions
Around the post wide ball
